_comment: Accuracy-check wand: 4 coloured markers (2 red, 2 teal) on a rigid T-frame. Ground-truth marker-to-marker distances measured 2026-08-17. Used by occ.accuracy_check to report reconstruction error in mm.
notes: M1-M2 is the long crossbar axis (use vertical poses to test the Z/clearance axis). M3-M4 is the stem axis. M1-M3 and M2-M3 are diagonals. Distances are directly-measured ground truth; do not derive from junction offsets.
